name: deployment-polish
goal: Opus polishes promotion, activity and shared deployment details while preserving single-action production and concurrent directional progress

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Visual scope recorded in environment-deploy-controls specification; baseline unchanged deployment-activity browser scenarios pass 3/3 with fresh opus-before screenshots. Preserve routes, identity, status, one production action, keyboard and mobile.

steps.evidence: Strengthened standardized deployment scenarios for mobile full commits and verified success. Route semantic grouping failed first in component and browser tests, then passed unchanged after repair; all 8 component and 3 affected browser tests pass.
